services.name: Raft It
services.desc: Get up close and personal with the river on a family rafting tour at Ausable Chasm. The scenic float tours are an exciting and memorable experience for the entire family. There is no minimum age for rafting, guests must be 30 lbs. and up*. Departing from the formidable Table Rock, your rafting journey begins between the towering cliffs of the Grand Flume, the narrowest and deepest section of Ausable Chasm. Your guide will show you stunning rock formations such as the Sentry Box and Broken Needle before navigating through the rapids and around the Whirlpool Basin. services.name: Cabin Rentals
services.desc: The Adirondacks are well known for their rich camping history. We have eight cabins available to rent for your own Adirondack camping experience. We have two categories of cabins to choose from, one sleeping up to four people (bunk beds and a double), and one sleeping up to three people (twin bed and a single bed). Please bring your own linens and sleeping bags, as we do not provide those. Enjoy an outside grill, fire ring, and picnic table at your cabin, with restrooms and showers only a short walk away at the campground lodge. Electricity is supplied to our camping cabins. services.name: disc golf
services.desc: The Ausable Chasm Disc Golf Course (DGC) is now open! Disc golf, also known as Frisbee golf, is played like regular golf except players use flying discs instead of clubs and balls. You score by tossing the disc into a metal basket on a pole, instead of sinking a ball into a hole in the ground. This addictive game is one of the fastest growing sports in the world with over 3,000 courses in America. The Ausable Chasm Disc Golf Course is located in a dense pine forest at our Campground and Recreation Center.
